checks.message: Valid frontmatter identity and matching folder/metadata identity.
Declare title/displayName, at least one tag and difficulty.
Declare non-placeholder author, license, version and source provenance.
Declare risk level and at least one capability.
Explain activation in the description and When to use section.
Provide nonempty When to use, Inputs, Workflow, Output and Boundaries sections.
Provide at least three top-level numbered workflow steps; fenced examples do not count.
Describe the output using a list or fenced format inside Output.
Reference a nonempty input example and expected output example.
Supply at least two distinct input and output examples; content accuracy needs review.
All inspected Markdown and example references stay within the package and resolve, or use supported external schemes.
Pass existing path, type, size, collision, UTF-8-text and raw-HTML checks. No scripts execute.

safety.concerns: Assessment rules, minors privacy and unsupported learning/diagnosis claims require attention.
safety.authoredBoundaries:
- Do not fabricate citations, learner responses, grades or test results. Use the provided problem and state uncertainty rather than inventing missing source material.
- Do not request full name, school records, diagnosis or other sensitive personal data when a topic and rough level suffice. Tools or file access are optional and require the user’s authorization.
- Respect explicit assessment rules, avoid shaming language and do not make medical/psychological diagnoses. This skill supports learning rather than guaranteeing academic outcomes.
safety.verification: Static checks and preliminary content triage only; no security certification or domain approval.

originality.declaredProvenance: Original Open Skill Kit initial-milestone package. Examples and test inputs are fictional, authored for this project. Authoring self-review is recorded in review.md; independent human review and model execution are pending.
originality.limitation: Self-declared provenance and local exact-copy indicators only. No external plagiarism search, authorship authentication or originality certification.

usefulness.proposedTask: Explain supplied concepts and respond to learner attempts.
usefulness.expectedOutput:
For a concise explanation, return a plain-language mental model, a reasoned example and one understanding check. For feedback, identify the learner’s actual mistaken step, correct the reasoning and offer a nearby practice question. For a requested study sheet, separate explanation, practice and any authorized solution key.

Do not invent dialogue turns or say the learner has mastered a topic before their responses support that conclusion. Make mathematical equality, units and assumptions visible enough for the learner to check.
usefulness.limitation: Editorial task fit, not demonstrated user value or measured effectiveness.
